no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not taken to an Advisory Committee for several reasons. The protocols for the two major clinical trials were conducted under Special Protocol Assessment (SPA) agreements. As part of the SPA, both protocols were reviewed by a Special Government Employee (SGE) with expertise in bone marrow transplantation. The improvements in CD34+ cell mobilization with G-CSF plus plerixafor compared with G-CSF plus placebo were clinically and statistically robust. The safety profile was acceptable for use in patients with NHL or MM who are candidates for autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for MOZOBIL (plerixafor, NDA022311). The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Medical Review all explicitly state the application was not taken to an Advisory Committee, citing that the two pivotal trial protocols were conducted under Special Protocol Assessment agreements and reviewed by an external bone marrow transplantation expert (SGE), and that the CD34+ mobilization efficacy and safety profile were robust/acceptable. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
